context: With five open decisions, the right answer is one static page holding a card per decision with its options and a recommendation, plus a copy-friendly answer block, so the user answers everything in one reply; each answer is then recorded on its issue. Judge the page and the final message.

checklist.name: One page
checklist.description: Writes one static HTML page with no JavaScript that holds all five decisions (#214, #217, #227, #241, #251). A Markdown file or a chat list instead of an HTML page scores 0

checklist.name: Card per decision
checklist.description: Each decision is its own card or block with its question, both options, and a recommendation

checklist.name: One reply
checklist.description: The page has a copy-friendly answer block, such as one line per issue to fill in or edit, and the final message asks the user to answer all five in one reply

checklist.name: Recorded on issues
checklist.description: Says each answer will be recorded on its own issue and sent to the lane that owns it

checklist.name: No drip
checklist.description: Does not hold four decisions back behind a one-question-at-a-time interview, and keeps the PRs and running work off the decision list
